plurals.name: onboarding_welcome_subtitle
plurals.item: WM Keyboard works offline and types in many languages. It has %1$d language built in, with phonetic and native layouts, glide typing and themes. First, set it as your keyboard.
WM Keyboard works offline and types in many languages. It has %1$d languages built in, with phonetic and native layouts, glide typing and themes. First, set it as your keyboard.

resources.string: The next steps set up the choices that differ for each person: languages, look, feel and gestures. You can change all of them later in settings.

plurals.name: onboarding_languages_subtitle
plurals.item: Add as many languages as you want. Swipe on the spacebar to change language, or press the 🌐 key. All %1$d language is built in, so add the one you need now or later in Settings, then Languages.
Add as many languages as you want. Swipe on the spacebar to change language, or press the 🌐 key. All %1$d languages are built in, so add the ones you need now or later in Settings, then Languages.

resources.string: These come from the language settings and the region of your device. The app does not read what you type, and no data leaves your device.
Every language is already in your list.

plurals.name: onboarding_language_more_count
plurals.item: %1$d more language matches. Search to make the list shorter.
%1$d more languages match. Search to make the list shorter.

resources.string: Select how the keyboard and the app look. AMOLED is fully black for OLED screens. Material You takes its colors from your wallpaper.
The keyboard takes its colors from your wallpaper. Android 12 and later only
You can find custom colors, background images, import and export in Appearance, then Keyboard themes.

The toolbar always shows. It holds the suggestions, the tools and the toolbox. You select whether to show the emoji row and the symbol row. You can change their order and their content later in Rows and bars.
One press for special characters and snippets, such as @gmail.com, https:// and brackets
Each device has its own emoji images. Old devices cannot draw the newest emoji, and they show an empty box instead.

plurals.name: onboarding_emoji_missing_count
plurals.item: Your device cannot draw %1$d emoji in the catalog. It shows an empty box instead.
Your device cannot draw %1$d emoji in the catalog. They show as empty boxes instead.

resources.string: Hide the emoji your device cannot draw
The emoji panel, the search and the suggestions leave out the empty boxes

To see all of the emoji, use a complete emoji font. Select \"Google\" (Noto Color Emoji), or import an emoji font file such as Twemoji or OpenMoji. Both are in Emoji, then Emoji font. WM Keyboard uses the emoji font of your device and includes no font of its own. You can change all of this later in Settings, then Emoji.
Some people want a signal for each key press. Other people want silence. The strength, the duration and the popups are in Typing settings.
The device vibrates on each key press
The device makes a click sound on each key press
A bubble shows the character above the key you press
A sideways swipe on the spacebar is the fastest way to change language or move the text cursor. Select what it does.
A quick swipe moves the cursor. Press and hold, then swipe to change language
A quick swipe changes the language. Press and hold, then swipe to move the cursor
Each swipe on the spacebar goes to your next language
Each swipe on the spacebar moves the text cursor
The keyboard ignores swipes on the spacebar
The 🌐 key becomes an emoji key. This is useful when the spacebar changes the language
A row of the numbers 1 to 0 above the letters
The toolbox holds everything from GIFs to a calculator behind the grid button on the toolbar. Start with only the tools you use. You can turn each one on or off at any time in Tools settings.
Some of the tools you turned on have their own choices. You can change all of them later in the settings of each tool.
The month grid shows it next to the Gregorian month and in each day cell
A second calendar for the header and the day you select
Turn this off to see the temperature in Celsius
The compass rose marks the direction of the Kaaba
The qibla direction uses the same saved place as the weather tool.
